state:
Teledoc: a self-hosted Telegram channel document archive. A bot watches a Telegram channel; every document posted there is archived into a local SQLite database with auto-tagging, browsable via a web UI. Documents can carry a caption; #hashtags in the caption tag the document directly on upload (bypassing rules). A status-reaction feature reacts to the document message: thumbs-up = archived cleanly, eyes = duplicate filename reupload, thinking-face = archiving-or-tagging failed (needs attention).

Feature being implemented (design already fixed by the user): when a channel post's caption is EDITED after posting (adds a hashtag, fixes a typo), the bot re-runs caption-hashtag tagging on that message. Tagging is strictly ADD-ONLY: an edit can never remove a tag; tag removal happens only via the web UI. Re-applying a hashtag that is already on the document is a no-op (idempotent), so editing to fix an unrelated typo cannot change tags, and removing a hashtag from the caption leaves existing tags untouched.

Technical background: Telegram only delivers edits if the bot subscribes to edited_channel_post / edited_message updates. An edited post carries the full message including the document and new caption. The archived document is looked up by (chat_id, message_id). Caption edits cannot change the rules-engine outcome: rules only match on file name, extension and mime type, none of which an edit can alter, so only hashtags need re-processing. Documents posted before the bot was added are not in the archive; a document deleted via the web UI is also not in the archive.

unknown_message_edit.instructions: The bot receives an edit for a document post that is NOT in the archive (it predates the bot, or the user deleted it from the web UI). What should the edit handler do? Pick one.

criteria.ignore: Ignore the edit silently: only already-archived documents get re-tagged; deletion via the web UI stays authoritative and nothing is resurrected.
criteria.archive_and_tag: Archive it now (the update carries full document metadata) and apply its hashtags: recovers documents the bot missed, but resurrects documents the user explicitly deleted from the archive.

edit_reaction.instructions: The bot re-tags after a caption edit. What should happen to the message's status reaction (which currently shows the state from upload time, e.g. thumbs-up)? Pick one. Background: setMessageReaction replaces the bot's single previous reaction on that message.

criteria.leave_on_success_flag_on_failure: On success (or nothing-to-add): leave the existing reaction untouched — archive state did not change. On failure (database error applying hashtags): switch to thinking-face so the channel flags the message needs attention.
criteria.always_reassert: Re-assert the archived thumbs-up after every successful edit: confirms the bot processed the edit, but the emoji never visibly changes so it communicates nothing new.
criteria.never_touch: Never touch the reaction on edits, even on failure: failures are only visible in logs, keeping the reaction purely an upload-time status.
